name: project-data-writes-session
description: The page starts at the library with one project, then writes the project data of that project through patches that the host answers later: two writes in a row, a read that a write outran, refused writes, replaces from one read and replaces against stored values of each text form; the host sends a change notice before each read of the registry.
reason: The page start sends the theme of the window and reports the window ready (setTheme, windowReady), and the held replies of the patches are settled by the test, which the Go producer does not run; it runs only log and workspace without a window (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
